'''Rattlecoil''' is a [[Rock]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Taptail]] at 6 bronze stars, and evolves into [[Clangnaga]] at 18 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Defeating Zobos must be a faster way of earning karma than head-tapping, right? Either way, doing both should cover everything..."

Rattlecoil is a gold rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
TBA

== Evolution Trial ==
Rattlecoil's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 18 stars. To evolve it into [[Clangnaga]] you need to complete the following two tasks:

* Feed Rattlecoil to increase stats 3 times.
* In [[Island Gold Rush]] use 5,000 energy drinks.

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "Rattlecoil doesn't know why if it taps its head, someone will bow respectfully and give it a candy."
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "Rattlecoils repeatedly open and close their mouths when tapping, as if chanting along. Doing this day after day helps accumulate good karma."
